description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a weave‑frame structural block containing interdependent weave and frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::WEAVEFRAME

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [FRAME-A]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::F1
    MODE::PRIMARY

  [FRAME-B]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::F2
    MODE::SECONDARY

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    FRAMESET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    FRAMESET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-WEAVEFRAME}
  K9-J8-H7-G6

<END-WEAVEFRAME>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire weaveframe block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
